subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should OpenClaw expose a user-facing TUI display-name override, and should the accepted surface be CLI-only, persisted config-backed, or auto-derived?
rationale: The technical path can reuse the existing Gateway `clientDisplayName` seam, but adding an identity field creates public CLI/config-adjacent behavior and privacy tradeoffs for Gateway-visible metadata.

options.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode, keep the current default unchanged, and document privacy-safe usage.

options.title: Add Persisted TUI Config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema, docs, tests, and no upgrade surprise for existing users.

options.title: Defer Or Decline
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the only TUI label until a broader identity and privacy policy is decided.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-Only Opt-In Flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode, keep the current default unchanged, and document privacy-safe usage.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is public TUI/CLI product behavior rather than only Gateway plumbing, and this handle is tied to the current label-family rename history.
